{
  "goal": "Create textutil.py with slugify(text) that lowercases, replaces non-alphanumeric runs with hyphens, strips leading/trailing hyphens, and raises TypeError for non-str input.",
  "context": "Plain Python 3, stdlib only, no network. The function must handle ASCII and non-ASCII letters (non-ASCII letters count as non-alphanumeric).",
  "done": "textutil.py exists with slugify working per spec.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "title": "Create textutil.py with slugify(text) function",
      "files": ["textutil.py"],
      "size": "S",
      "asserts": [
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "slugify", "args": ["Hello World"], "expect": "hello-world"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "slugify", "args": ["  Foo,  Bar!! "], "expect": "foo-bar"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "slugify", "args": ["a--b"], "expect": "a-b"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "slugify", "args": ["Café au lait"], "expect": "caf-au-lait"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "slugify", "args": ["", ""], "expect": ""},
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "slugify", "args": ["---", ""], "expect": ""},
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "slugify", "args": [123], "raises": "TypeError"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Add truncate(text, width, suffix) to textutil.py",
      "files": ["textutil.py"],
      "size": "S",
      "asserts": [
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "truncate", "args": ["hello world", 8, "..."], "expect": "hello..."},
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "truncate", "args": ["hello world", 2, "..."], "expect": ".."},
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "truncate", "args": ["hello", 0, "..."], "expect": ""},
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "truncate", "args": ["hello world", 10, "..."], "expect": "hello world"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "textutil", "func": "truncate", "args": [-1, 5, "..."], "raises": "ValueError"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Create numutil.py with clamp(value, low, high) function",
      "files": ["numutil.py"],
      "size": "S",
      "asserts": [
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "clamp", "args": [5, 1, 3], "expect": 3},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "clamp", "args": [-1, 0, 10], "expect": 0},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "clamp", "args": [2.5, 0, 10], "expect": 2.5},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "clamp", "args": [5, 3, 1], "raises": "ValueError"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "clamp", "args": [3, 3, 3], "expect": 3}
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Add is_prime(n) to numutil.py",
      "files": ["numutil.py"],
      "size": "S",
      "asserts": [
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "is_prime", "args": [2], "expect": true},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "is_prime", "args": [97], "expect": true},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "is_prime", "args": [1], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "is_prime", "args": [0], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "is_prime", "args": [-7], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "is_prime", "args": [561], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "is_prime", "args": [1000000007], "expect": true},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "is_prime", "args": [true], "raises": "TypeError"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "numutil", "func": "is_prime", "args": [3.5], "raises": "TypeError"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Create fileutil.py with safe_filename(name) function",
      "files": ["fileutil.py"],
      "size": "S",
      "asserts": [
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "safe_filename", "args": ["report 2024.pdf"], "expect": "report_2024.pdf"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "safe_filename", "args": ["../etc/passwd"], "expect": "_etc_passwd"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "safe_filename", "args": ["naïve.txt"], "expect": "na_ve.txt"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "safe_filename", "args": ["...", "unnamed"], "expect": "unnamed"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "safe_filename", "args": ["", "unnamed"], "expect": "unnamed"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "safe_filename", "args": ["a  b"], "expect": "a__b"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Add split_ext(name) to fileutil.py",
      "files": ["fileutil.py"],
      "size": "S",
      "asserts": [
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "split_ext", "args": ["archive.tar.gz"], "expect": ["archive.tar", ".gz"]},
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "split_ext", "args": ["README"], "expect": ["README", ""]},
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "split_ext", "args": [".bashrc"], "expect": [".bashrc", ""]},
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "split_ext", "args": ["a."], "expect": ["a.", ""]},
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "split_ext", "args": ["photo.JPG"], "expect": ["photo", ".JPG"]},
        {"type": "call", "module": "fileutil", "func": "split_ext", "args": ["path/to/file"], "raises": "ValueError"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Create netutil.py with is_valid_ipv4(text) function",
      "files": ["netutil.py"],
      "size": "S",
      "asserts": [
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": ["192.168.1.1"], "expect": true},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": ["0.0.0.0"], "expect": true},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": ["255.255.255.255"], "expect": true},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": ["256.1.1.1"], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": ["1.2.3"], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": ["1.2.3.4.5"], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": ["01.2.3.4"], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": ["1.2.3.4 "], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": ["-1.2.3.4"], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": ["", false], "expect": false},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "is_valid_ipv4", "args": [123], "expect": false}
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Add ipv4_to_int(text) to netutil.py",
      "files": ["netutil.py"],
      "size": "S",
      "asserts": [
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "ipv4_to_int", "args": ["0.0.0.1"], "expect": 1},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "ipv4_to_int", "args": ["1.0.0.0"], "expect": 16777216},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "ipv4_to_int", "args": ["192.168.0.1"], "expect": 3232235521},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "ipv4_to_int", "args": ["255.255.255.255"], "expect": 4294967295},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "ipv4_to_int", "args": ["256.1.1.1"], "raises": "ValueError"},
        {"type": "call", "module": "netutil", "func": "ipv4_to_int", "args": ["1.2.3"], "raises": "ValueError"}
      ]
    }
  ]
}

{
  "title": "Implement stdin mode: when no args, read lines from stdin, evaluate each, print result or error, skip empty lines, exit 0",
  "files": ["main.go"],
  "size": "S",
  "asserts": [
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","2 + 3"],"stdout":"5\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","10 - 4"],"stdout":"6\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","9 / 3"],"stdout":"3\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","2 + 3 * 4"],"stdout":"14\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","-2.5 + 1"],"stdout":"-1.5\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","6 x 7"],"stdout":"42\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","2.5 * 2"],"stdout":"5\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","1 / 3"],"stdout":"0.3333333333333333\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","10 - 4 - 3"],"stdout":"3\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","8 / 4 / 2"],"stdout":"1\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","2 * 3 + 4 * 5"],"stdout":"26\n","exit":0},
    {"type":"run","argv":["go run .","-3 * -3"],"stdout":"9\n","exit":0}
  ]
}
